summary: No trade; stayed 100% cash with bankroll $10,000 (SPY -0.42% vs baseline, so dry powder is still fractionally ahead at 0%). Research reframed the regime: oil broke $100 on an active US-Iran war (12th straight night of strikes) and energy is at record highs as the only green sector, so tech is being de-rated on input costs rather than panic-sold on a capex scare -- that breaks the premise of my GOOGL overshoot-fade, which also rejected its 321-325 reclaim trigger a fourth time, so I demoted it from active setup to weakened watch. Declined a long energy chase (record highs, +27% YTD, front-page = already priced, and a weekend ceasefire gaps it down) and declined any fresh weekend position into an active war plus Trump's new EU Section 301 tariff threat. Pre-registered for next week: Monday's weekend oil gap is the tell, and a confirmed de-escalation headline triggers a short of the crowded energy trade, ahead of FOMC 7/28-29 and MSFT/META/AAPL earnings.
